description: Check a run started with a start_ tool and fetch its results. Needs the receipt_id AND the access_token that start_ returned: the token is the proof that the caller started the run, and without it nothing is returned. Status is awaiting_payment (the user has not paid yet), running, completed or failed. When completed, structuredContent.result is the bot's full JSON result, ready to act on, and pdf_url links the PDF report (presigned, expires after 7 days). Free and read-only; poll about once a minute.
name: get_run
title: Get run status and results
